f.title: Treat consumer reports with one medically confirmed reaction as HCP-confirmed
f.statement: If a consumer initially reports more than one reaction and at least one is medically confirmed, the whole report should be documented and reported as a spontaneous report confirmed by an HCP. Likewise, a report submitted by a medically qualified patient, friend, relative or carer should be considered an HCP-confirmed spontaneous report.

Benzer şekilde, eğer bir rapor tıbbi vasıflara sahip bir hasta, arkadaş, hasta yakını ya da bakıcısı tarafından gönderilirse, bu olgu da bir sağlık mesleği mensubu tarafından teyit edilmiş spontan bir rapor olarak kabul edilmelidir.

f.title: Assess seriousness at the time of the reaction and apply medical judgement for important medical events
f.statement: To determine seriousness, the features/outcomes at the time of the reaction should be considered (e.g. "life-threatening" means the patient was at risk of death at the time of the reaction, not a reaction that might have caused death if more severe). Medical and scientific judgement should be applied to decide whether other situations are serious; important medical events that may jeopardise the patient or require intervention to prevent one of the listed outcomes should be considered serious.

rows.quote: Bir olgunun ciddiyetini belirlemek için, advers reaksiyon sırasındaki özellikler/sonuçlar dikkate alınmalıdır. Örneğin, “yaşamı tehdit edici” ifadesi, reaksiyon meydana geldiği sırada hastanın ölüm riski altında olduğu bir reaksiyon anlamına gelir; daha şiddetli olsaydı ölüme neden olabilecek olan bir reaksiyon bu tanıma dahil değildir. Diğer durumların ciddi reaksiyonlar olarak kabul edilip edilmeyeceğine karar verilirken tıbbi ve bilimsel yargıya başvurulmalıdır. Bazı tıbbi olaylar, hastayı tehlikeye atabilir ya da yukarıdaki sonuçlardan birinin önlenmesi için bir müdahale gerektirebilir. Bu tür önemli tıbbi olaylar “ciddi” olarak kabul edilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts; includes an explanatory example. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: To determine the seriousness of a case, the characteristics/outcomes at the time of the adverse reaction should be taken into account. For example, "life-threatening" refers to a reaction in which the patient was at risk of death at the time of the reaction; a reaction that might have caused death if it were more severe is not included in this definition. Medical and scientific judgement should be exercised in deciding whether other situations should be considered serious reactions. Some medical events may jeopardise the patient or may require an intervention to prevent one of the above outcomes. Such important medical events should be considered "serious".

f.title: Collect and manage all suspected ADR reports through a well-designed PV system
f.statement: MAHs should take all measures to collect and manage all suspected adverse reaction reports from solicited or unsolicited sources, and should develop a PV system allowing sufficient information for scientific evaluation, designed so that reports collected are authentic, legible, accurate, consistent, verifiable and as complete as possible for clinical assessment.

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahipleri, talepte bulunulan ya da bulunulmayan kaynaklardan alınan tüm şüpheli advers reaksiyon raporlarını toplamak ve yönetmek için tüm tedbirleri almalıdır. Bu amaçla, bu raporların bilimsel değerlendirmesi için yeterli bilginin alınmasına olanak sağlamak üzere bir farmakovijilans sistemi geliştirilmelidir. Bu sistem, toplanan raporların gerçek, okunaklı, doğru, tutarlı, doğrulanabilir ve klinik değerlendirme için mümkün olduğu kadar eksiksiz olmasına yardımcı olacak şekilde tasarlanmalıdır.

rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders should take all measures to collect and manage all reports of suspected adverse reactions received from solicited or unsolicited sources. For this purpose, a pharmacovigilance system should be developed to allow sufficient information to be obtained for the scientific evaluation of these reports. This system should be designed so as to help ensure that the reports collected are authentic, legible, accurate, consistent, verifiable and as complete as possible for clinical assessment.

rows.quote: Bu veri toplama sistemlerinin herhangi birinden elde edilen advers reaksiyon raporları spontan raporlar olarak kabul edilmemelidir. Burada istisna, advers olayların aktif olarak aranmadığı endikasyon dışı ilaç kullanımında ortaya çıkan şüpheli advers reaksiyonlardır. Klinik çalışmalardan elde edilen bildirimler “Klinik Araştırmalar Hakkında Yönetmelik” ve ilgili kılavuzlara göre yürütülür.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: mixes a -meli duty with a descriptive sentence on clinical-trial reports ("yürütülür"); actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Adverse reaction reports obtained from any of these data collection systems should not be considered spontaneous reports. The exception is suspected adverse reactions arising in off-label use in which adverse events are not actively sought. Reports from clinical trials are handled in accordance with the "Regulation on Clinical Trials" and the related guidelines.

f.title: Assess solicited cases for causality and report only suspected-related reactions flagged as solicited
f.statement: MAHs should have a system to collect complete and understandable case information and assess whether collected adverse events may relate to the monitored medicine or need processing as ICSRs, with appropriate causality assessment. Only adverse reactions suspected by the primary source or the recipient to be related should be reported; they should be treated as solicited and reports to TITCK should state that the report is from a solicited source, not spontaneous.

rows.quote: Toplanan advers olayların izlenen ilaç ile olası bir ilgisinin olup olmadığı veya şüpheli advers reaksiyonların BOGR olarak sınıflandırıp işlenmelerinin gerekli olup olmadığını belirlemek için ruhsat sahiplerinin eksiksiz ve anlaşılır biçimde olgu bilgisi toplayacak ve bu bilgiyi değerlendirecek bir sistemi olmalı ve uygun şekilde nedensellik değerlendirmesi yapılmalıdır. Yalnızca, birincil kaynak veya olguyu alan kişi tarafından, çalışılan ilaç ile ilgisi olduğundan şüphelenilen advers reaksiyonlar bildirilmelidir. Bu raporlar talep edilen raporlar olarak görülmeli ve Kuruma yapılan bildirimlerde raporun spontan rapor olmayıp, talep edilen bir kaynaktan elde edilen rapor olduğu vurgulanmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: long compound row (system, causality, reporting, flagging); level fine. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders should have a system to collect complete and comprehensible case information and to evaluate that information in order to determine whether the adverse events collected may be related to the monitored medicine or whether the suspected adverse reactions need to be classified and processed as ICSRs, and causality should be assessed appropriately. Only adverse reactions suspected by the primary source or by the person receiving the case to be related to the medicine studied should be reported. These reports should be regarded as solicited reports, and in reports to the Agency it should be emphasised that the report is not a spontaneous report but a report from a solicited source.

f.title: Assess PSP adverse events and submit only serious related ADRs to TÜFAM
f.statement: Adverse events from patient support programmes should first be assessed by the MAH's PV department and only reports containing serious adverse reactions submitted to TÜFAM; where in doubt, the MAH should contact the physician to query causality and submit only those suspected to be drug-related.

rows.quote: Söz konusu advers olaylar öncelikle ruhsat sahibinin farmakovijilans bölümü tarafından değerlendirilmeli, sadece ciddi advers reaksiyon yer alan bildirimler TÜFAM’a sunulmalıdır. Ruhsat sahibi, bu değerlendirmeyle ilgili tereddütünün olduğu durumlarda ilgili hekime ulaşarak nedensellik ilişkisini sorgulamalı ve sadece ilaçla ilişkili olduğu şüphesi bulunanları TÜFAM’a sunmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote starts "Söz konusu advers olaylar" without its lead-in naming the patient support programme; statement relies on the preceding sentence. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: These adverse events should first be evaluated by the marketing authorisation holder's pharmacovigilance department, and only reports containing a serious adverse reaction should be submitted to TÜFAM. Where the marketing authorisation holder has doubts about this evaluation, it should contact the physician concerned to query the causal relationship and should submit to TÜFAM only those suspected to be related to the medicine.

f.title: Forward PSP reports on other MAHs' products to that MAH for reporting
f.statement: Reports on medicines other than the PSP medicine, with no interaction with it, should be forwarded by the MAH running the PSP to the MAH of the suspect medicine, which should report them to TÜFAM per reporting requirements, stating that the report was identified during another MAH's patient support programme.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Hasta destek programının konusu olan ilaç dışındaki diğer ilaçlarla ilişkili advers reaksiyon raporları da ortaya çıkabilir. Bu durumda takip edilen ilaç ile bir etkileşim yoksa bu raporlar hasta destek programını yürüten ruhsat sahibi tarafından şüpheli ilacın ruhsat sahibine bildirilmelidir. İlgili ruhsat sahibi de bu raporu raporlama gereklerine uygun olarak TÜFAM’a bildirmelidir. TÜFAM’a bildirim yapılırken raporun başka bir ruhsat sahibinin hasta destek programı sırasında tespit edildiği de belirtilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified: quote names both MAHs and the -meli duties; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Adverse reaction reports related to medicines other than the medicine that is the subject of the patient support programme may also arise. In this case, if there is no interaction with the monitored medicine, these reports should be notified by the marketing authorisation holder running the patient support programme to the marketing authorisation holder of the suspected medicine. That marketing authorisation holder should in turn report this report to TÜFAM in accordance with the reporting requirements. When reporting to TÜFAM it should also be stated that the report was identified during another marketing authorisation holder's patient support programme.

f.title: Validate reports and include an identifiable reporter before reporting
f.statement: Before reporting to TITCK, all suspected adverse reactions should be validated to make sure the minimum criteria are included, and only valid ICSRs reported. The minimum criteria include an identifiable reporter (primary source) identified by qualification, name, initials or address; where possible reporter contact details should be recorded for follow-up; if the reporter does not wish to give contact details, the receiving party confirms this with the reporter and states it in the ICSR; all parties providing case information, not only the reporter, should be identifiable.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Tüm şüpheli advers reaksiyonlar Kuruma bildirilmeden önce, raporlara bildirim için asgari kriterlerin dahil edilmiş olduğundan emin olmak amacıyla valide edilmeli ve yalnızca geçerli BOGR’ler bildirilmelidir. Asgari kriterler şunlardır:  Mesleki vasıfları (örn; hekim, eczacı, diş hekimi, hemşire, ebe, avukat, tüketici ya da sağlık mesleği mensubu olmayan diğer bir kişi), ismi, adının-soyadının baş harfleri ya da adresi ile tanımlanabilen kimliği tespit edilebilir bir raportör (birincil kaynak). Mümkün olan durumlarda, takip faaliyetlerinin gerçekleştirilebilmesi için raportörün irtibat bilgileri kaydedilmelidir. Ancak raportör irtibat bilgilerini vermek istemiyorsa, raporu alan taraf bunu raportör ile teyit eder ve BOGR’de bu hususu belirtir. Yalnızca raportörün değil, olgu bilgilerini sağlayan tüm tarafların kimliği tespit edilebilir olmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: list-derived (minimum criteria bullets) and partly present-tense ("teyit eder ... belirtir"); level a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Before being reported to the Agency, all suspected adverse reactions should be validated to make sure that the minimum criteria for reporting are included in the reports, and only valid ICSRs should be reported. The minimum criteria are: an identifiable reporter (primary source), identified by qualification (e.g. physician, pharmacist, dentist, nurse, midwife, lawyer, consumer or other non-healthcare professional), name, initials or address. Where possible, the reporter's contact details should be recorded so that follow-up activities can be carried out. However, if the reporter does not wish to provide contact details, the party receiving the report confirms this with the reporter and states it in the ICSR. Not only the reporter but all parties providing case information should be identifiable.

f.title: Include identifiable patient, suspect drug and suspect reaction as minimum criteria
f.statement: The minimum criteria also include a single identifiable patient (initials, file number, date of birth, age, age group or address, information as complete as possible), one or more suspect substances/medicines (classification as suspect, interacting or concomitant based on the primary source), and one or more suspected adverse reactions.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Adının-soyadının baş harfleri, dosya numarası, doğum tarihi, yaşı, yaş grubu ya da adresi ile tanımlanabilen kimliği tespit edilebilir tek bir hasta. Bilgiler mümkün olduğu kadar eksiksiz olmalıdır.  Bir ya da daha fazla şüpheli madde/ilaç (İlaçların şüpheli, etkileşen veya eş zamanlı kullanılan ilaç olarak sınıflandırılmasında birincil kaynak tarafından sağlanan bilgi temel alınır).  Bir ya da daha fazla şüpheli advers reaksiyon.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote is bullet-list items without the lead-in "Asgari kriterler şunlardır"; statement supplies the framing. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: One single identifiable patient, identified by initials, file number, date of birth, age, age group or address. The information should be as complete as possible. One or more suspected substances/medicines (the classification of medicines as suspected, interacting or concomitant is based on the information provided by the primary source). One or more suspected adverse reactions.

f.title: Do not treat reports with explicit no-causality or unspecified reactions as valid ICSRs
f.statement: If the primary source explicitly states there is no causal relationship between the medicine and the adverse event and the receiving party (TITCK or MAH) accepts this, the report is not a valid ICSR because minimum information is missing (no suspect medicine). Likewise a report stating that the patient experienced an unspecified adverse reaction, with no information on its type, is not accepted as a valid ICSR.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Birincil kaynak, ilaç ile advers olay arasında nedensellik ilişkisinin olmadığını açıkça beyan etmiş ve raporu alan taraf (Kurum ya da ruhsat sahibi) bunu kabul etmişse, minimum bilgi eksik olduğundan (şüpheli ilaç bulunmadığından) rapor geçerli bir BOGR sayılmaz. Ayrıca hastanın belirtilmemiş bir advers reaksiyon yaşadığının bildirildiği ve yaşanan advers reaksiyonun tipi hakkında hiçbir bilgi verilmediği durumlarda da rapor geçerli bir BOGR olarak kabul edilmez.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: level changed Mandatory -> Recommended: present-tense validity definition ("sayılmaz", "kabul edilmez") that sets no step; same treatment as 0147. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: If the primary source has explicitly stated that there is no causal relationship between the medicine and the adverse event and the party receiving the report (the Agency or the marketing authorisation holder) has accepted this, the report does not count as a valid ICSR because the minimum information is incomplete (there is no suspected medicine). The report is also not regarded as a valid ICSR where it is reported that the patient experienced an unspecified adverse reaction and no information is given on the type of adverse reaction experienced.

f.title: Do not treat outcome-only reports as valid and apply medical judgement
f.statement: Similarly, if only an outcome is reported and (i) no clinical information allows it to be considered a suspected adverse reaction, or (ii) the primary source does not indicate a possible causal relationship, the report is not valid (e.g. the MAH is told only that the patient was hospitalised or died). In such cases medical judgement should always be applied to decide whether the reported information is an adverse reaction or event.

rows.quote: Benzer şekilde, yalnızca bir sonlanım (ya da sonuç) bildirilmişse ve (i) bunun şüpheli bir advers reaksiyon olarak düşünülmesini sağlayacak hiçbir klinik durum bilgisi verilmemişse, ya da (ii) birincil kaynak şüpheli ilaç ile olası bir nedensellik ilişkisine işaret etmemişse rapor geçerli değildir. Örneğin, ruhsat sahibinin hastanın hastaneye yatırıldığından ya da öldüğünden haberdar edildiği ve başka hiçbir bilginin verilmediği durumlar. Böyle durumlarda, bildirilen bilginin bir advers reaksiyon ya da olay olup olmadığına karar verilirken daima tıbbi yargıya başvurulmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: mostly a validity definition with one -malı duty; actor "TITCK and MAH" inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Similarly, the report is not valid if only an outcome (or consequence) is reported and (i) no information on the clinical circumstances is given that would allow it to be considered a suspected adverse reaction, or (ii) the primary source has not indicated a possible causal relationship with the suspected medicine. For example, situations in which the marketing authorisation holder is informed that the patient was hospitalised or died and no other information is given. In such situations, medical judgement should always be applied when deciding whether the reported information is an adverse reaction or an event.

f.title: Treat sudden death reports as suspected adverse reactions and report them
f.statement: For example, a sudden death report should generally be considered a suspected adverse reaction case and reported.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Örneğin, bir ani ölüm raporu genellikle şüpheli advers Doküman No İlk Yayın Tarihi Revizyon Tarihi Revizyon No Sayfa FVK-KLVZ-01 12/06/2014 15/11/2022 1 9/28 reaksiyon olgusu olarak kabul edilmeli ve bildirilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote spans the page 9 running header between "advers" and "reaksiyon"; verbatim as in text. Double-check: quote includes the running page header (Doküman No ... page/28) inside the sentence; "genellikle" (generally) qualifies the duty. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For example, a report of sudden death should usually be regarded as a case of suspected adverse [page running header ... FVK-KLVZ-01 12/06/2014 15/11/2022 1 9/28] reaction and should be reported.

f.title: Follow up cases missing minimum elements
f.statement: The absence of any of the four elements means the case is incomplete and not eligible for reporting; MAHs must exercise due diligence in following up the case to collect the missing data elements.

rows.quote: Bu dört öğeden herhangi birinin mevcut olmaması, olgunun eksik olarak kabul edilmesi ve bildirim için uygun sayılmaması anlamına gelir. Ruhsat sahiplerinin, eksik veri öğelerini toplamak üzere olguyu takip etmek için gerekli özeni göstermeleri gerekir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified against the source: quote names the actor and proves the modal verb and the whole statement; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The absence of any of these four elements means that the case is considered incomplete and not qualifying for reporting. Marketing authorisation holders need to exercise due diligence in following up the case to collect the missing data elements.

f.title: Record reports lacking minimum information in the PV system
f.statement: Reports missing minimum information should nevertheless be recorded in the MAH's PV system for use in ongoing safety evaluation activities.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: Asgari bilgileri eksik olan raporlar, devam etmekte olan güvenlilik değerlendirme faaliyetlerinde kullanılmak üzere yine de ruhsat sahibinin farmakovijilans sistemine kaydedilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified against the source: quote names the actor and proves the modal verb and the whole statement; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Reports for which the minimum information is incomplete should nevertheless be recorded in the marketing authorisation holder's pharmacovigilance system for use in ongoing safety evaluation activities.

f.title: Include all information needed to detect duplicates in the ICSR
f.statement: When a party is informed that the primary source may also have reported the suspected adverse reaction to another party, all relevant information needed to detect the duplicate should be included in the ICSR.

rows.quote: Bir taraf (Kurum ya da ruhsat sahibi) birincil kaynağın şüpheli advers reaksiyonu başka bir ilgili tarafa da bildirmiş olabileceğinden haberdar edildiğinde, mükerrer olarak bildirilmiş olgunun saptanması için gereken tüm ilgili bilgiler BOGR’ye dahil edilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified: quote names the parties (Kurum ya da ruhsat sahibi); no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When a party (the Agency or the marketing authorisation holder) is informed that the primary source may also have reported the suspected adverse reaction to another party concerned, all relevant information necessary for detecting the duplicate case should be included in the ICSR.

f.title: Do not downgrade consumer cases when the contacted HCP disagrees
f.statement: A valid case first reported by a consumer cannot be downgraded to an unrelated adverse event if the contacted HCP does not agree with the consumer's suspicion; both the consumer's and the HCP's opinions should be included in the ICSR.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: İlk olarak bir tüketici tarafından bildirilmiş olan geçerli bir şüpheli advers reaksiyon olgusu, temas kurulan sağlık mesleği mensubunun (tüketici tarafından takip bilgileri için belirlenmiş olan kişi) tüketicinin şüphesini kabul etmemesi durumunda ilgili olmayan advers olay düzeyine düşürülemez. Bu durumda, hem tüketicinin, hem de sağlık mesleği mensubunun görüşleri BOGR’ye dahil edilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "düşürülemez" (cannot) plus a -meli sentence: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: A valid case of suspected adverse reaction initially reported by a consumer cannot be downgraded to an unrelated adverse event if the healthcare professional contacted (the person designated by the consumer for follow-up information) does not accept the consumer's suspicion. In this case, the opinions of both the consumer and the healthcare professional should be included in the ICSR.

f.title: Do not downgrade solicited cases or seriousness because the recipient disagrees
f.statement: For solicited reports where the recipient does not agree with the primary source's reasonable possibility of causality, the case should not be downgraded to an unrelated adverse event; both opinions should be recorded in the ICSR. Likewise, if the recipient disagrees with the seriousness reported by the primary source, the case should not be downgraded from serious to non-serious.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Talepte bulunulan kaynaklardan alınan (bkz. 2.1.2) ve birincil kaynağın belirttiği şüpheli ilaç ile advers reaksiyon arasındaki makul nedensellik ilişki olasılığını, raporu alan tarafın kabul etmediği şüpheli advers reaksiyon raporlarında, olgu “ilgili olmayan advers olay” düzeyine düşürülmemelidir. Hem birincil kaynağın, hem de raporu alan tarafın görüşleri BOGR’ye kaydedilmelidir. Aynı ilke BOGR ciddiyet kriteri için de geçerlidir; raporu alan taraf birincil kaynağın bildirdiği ciddiyet kriterini kabul etmiyorsa olgunun düzeyi ‘ciddi’den ‘ciddi değil’e düşürülmemelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In reports of suspected adverse reactions from solicited sources (see 2.1.2) in which the party receiving the report does not accept the reasonable possibility of a causal relationship between the suspected medicine and the adverse reaction stated by the primary source, the case should not be downgraded to the level of an "unrelated adverse event". The opinions of both the primary source and the party receiving the report should be recorded in the ICSR. The same principle applies to the ICSR seriousness criterion; if the party receiving the report does not accept the seriousness criterion reported by the primary source, the case should not be downgraded from 'serious' to 'non-serious'.

f.title: Follow up reports as needed and document all follow-up attempts
f.statement: Reports should be followed up as necessary to obtain supplementary detailed information significant for scientific evaluation; follow-up of events of special interest, prospective pregnancy reports, reports of death and reports of new risks or changes in known risks is particularly important. Follow-up should be performed in addition to efforts to collect missing minimum criteria (see 2.2), and all attempts to obtain follow-up information should be documented.

rows.quote: Bu raporlar, olguların bilimsel açıdan değerlendirilmesi için anlamlı olan tamamlayıcı detaylı bilgilerin elde edilmesi amacıyla gerektiği şekilde takip edilmelidir. Takip edilen özel ilgi konusu olaylar, prospektif gebelik raporları, hastanın öldüğünün bildirildiği olgular, yeni risklerin ya da bilinen risklerde değişikliğin bildirildiği olgular özellikle önemlidir. Eksik olan asgari raporlanabilirlik kriterleri ile ilgili bilgilerin toplanması için gösterilen tüm çabalara ek olarak takip işlemleri yapılmalıdır (bkz. 2.2). Takip bilgilerinin alınması için gerçekleştirilen tüm girişimler belgelenmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: These reports should be followed up as necessary to obtain supplementary detailed information that is significant for the scientific evaluation of the cases. Follow-up of events of special interest, prospective pregnancy reports, cases in which the patient is reported to have died, and cases reporting new risks or changes in known risks is particularly important. Follow-up should be carried out in addition to all efforts made to collect missing information relating to the minimum reportability criteria (see 2.2). All attempts made to obtain follow-up information should be documented.

f.title: Tailor follow-up methods and avoid burdening the reporter
f.statement: Follow-up methods should be tailored to the case; the primary source should be encouraged to submit significant new information, requests to repeat information already given or complete extensive questionnaires should be avoided, and pre-filling some fields of follow-up forms should be considered.

rows.quote: Takip yöntemleri, eksik bilgilerin en iyi şekilde toplanmasının sağlanması için olguya göre belirlenmelidir. Bu yapılırken, birincil kaynak olgu için anlamlı yeni bilgileri göndermeye teşvik edilmelidir. Birincil kaynaktan ilk raporda zaten verilmiş olan bilgileri tekrarlamasını ve/veya kapsamlı anketler doldurmasını talep etmekten kaçınılmalıdır; bu tür uygulamalar kaynağın gelecekte spontan bildirimde bulunma konusundaki isteğini kırabilir. Bu nedenle, takip rapor formlarının birincil kaynak tarafından doldurulmasını kolaylaştırmak amacıyla, bu formlardaki bazı veri alanlarının önceden doldurulması düşünülmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Follow-up methods should be tailored to the case to ensure the best collection of missing information. In doing so, the primary source should be encouraged to submit new information relevant to the case. Asking the primary source to repeat information already provided in the initial report and/or to complete extensive questionnaires should be avoided; such practices could discourage the source from making spontaneous reports in future. Therefore, pre-populating some data fields of follow-up report forms should be considered, to make it easier for the primary source to complete them.

f.title: Seek consumer permission to contact an HCP for incomplete reports
f.statement: If information provided directly by a consumer suggests an adverse reaction may have occurred and is incomplete, an attempt should be made to obtain consent to contact a nominated HCP for additional follow-up information.

rows.quote: Direkt olarak tüketicinin verdiği bilgiler bir advers reaksiyonun meydana gelmiş olabileceğini düşündürüyorsa ve bilgiler tam değilse, ek takip bilgilerini almak üzere belirlenmiş olan bir sağlık mesleği mensubu ile temas kurulması için olur alma girişiminde bulunulmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: If the information provided directly by the consumer suggests that an adverse reaction may have occurred and the information is incomplete, an attempt should be made to obtain permission to contact a designated healthcare professional to obtain additional follow-up information.

f.title: Take all measures to identify biological product name and batch number
f.statement: For suspected adverse reactions to biological medicines, all measures should be taken to clearly state the product name and batch number.

rows.quote: Biyolojik ilaçlar ile ilgili şüpheli advers reaksiyonlar için, doğası gereği ilgili ürünün kesin olarak tanımlanması özel önem taşımaktadır. Bu nedenle, ürünün adının ve seri numarasının açık olarak belirtilmesi için tüm tedbirler alınmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For suspected adverse reactions relating to biological medicines, the definite identification of the product concerned is of particular importance by its nature. Therefore, all measures should be taken to clearly state the name of the product and the batch number.

f.title: Store and process ADR data confidentially like other medical records
f.statement: Electronic data and written reports of suspected adverse reactions should be stored and processed in the same way as other medical records, respecting confidentiality rules on the identifiability of patients and reporters; the confidentiality of patient records containing personal identifiers (if given) should always be protected, and personal details identifying reporting HCPs should be kept confidential.

rows.quote: Şüpheli advers reaksiyonların elektronik verileri ve yazılı raporları, hastaların ve raportörlerin kimlik bilgilerinin tespit edilebilmesiyle ilgili gizlilik kurallarına uyularak diğer tıbbi kayıtlarla aynı şekilde saklanmalı ve işlenmelidir. Hastaların kişisel kimlik bilgilerini (verildiyse) içeren hasta kayıtlarının gizliliği her zaman korunmalıdır. Bildirimi yapan sağlık mesleği mensuplarının kimliğinin tespit edilebilmesini sağlayan kişisel bilgileri gizli tutulmalıdır.

f.title: Train PV staff on report processing and PV legislation
f.statement: Staff directly performing PV activities should receive appropriate training on the report processing activities they are responsible for and/or undertake, as well as on relevant PV legislation and guidelines.

f.title: Follow up pregnancy exposure reports for outcome and child development
f.statement: Reports where the embryo or fetus may have been exposed to medicines (maternal exposure or paternal exposure via semen) should be followed up for pregnancy outcome and child development after birth; recommendations of the guideline on exposure to medicines during pregnancy (to be published) should be considered, and a long half-life of the active substance or metabolites should be taken into account when assessing possible embryonic exposure from pre-pregnancy use.

rows.quote: Embriyo ya da fetüsün ilaç(lar)a maruz kalmış olabileceği (maternal maruziyet ya da bir ilacın paternal maruziyetten sonra semen yoluyla geçmesi şeklinde) raporlar, gebeliğin sonucu ve doğumdan sonra çocuğun gelişimi hakkında bilgi edinmek için takip edilmelidir. Bu özel durumlarda bilimsel değerlendirmenin kolaylaştırılması için, bilgilerin izlenmesinde, toplanmasında ve bildirilmesinde yayımlanacak olan “Gebelik sırasında tıbbi ürünlere maruziyete ilişkin kılavuz: Ruhsatlandırma sonrası verilere gereksinim duyulduğunda” adlı kılavuzda yer alan tavsiyeler dikkate alınmalıdır. Etkin maddenin ya da onun metabolitlerinden birinin yarılanma ömrü uzunsa, ilacın gebelikten önce alınmış olması halinde embriyonun ilaca maruz kalma olasılığı değerlendirilirken bu durum hesaba katılmalıdır.

rows.quote_en: Reports in which the embryo or foetus may have been exposed to medicine(s) (either through maternal exposure or through transmission of a medicine via semen following paternal exposure) should be followed up to obtain information on the outcome of the pregnancy and the development of the child after birth. To facilitate scientific evaluation in these special situations, the recommendations in the guideline to be published entitled "Guideline on the exposure to medicinal products during pregnancy: need for post-authorisation data" should be taken into account in monitoring, collecting and reporting the information. If the half-life of the active substance or one of its metabolites is long, this should be taken into account when assessing the possibility of exposure of the embryo where the medicine was taken before pregnancy.

f.title: Make reasonable efforts to follow pregnancy outcome after enquiry calls
f.statement: When pregnant women or HCPs call the MAH for information on teratogenic effects or use in pregnancy, reasonable efforts should be made to obtain information on possible embryo or fetal exposure and to follow up the pregnancy outcome.

rows.quote: Gebeler ya da sağlık mesleği mensupları bir ilacın teratojenik etkileri ya da gebelikte kullanımı hakkında bilgi almak için ruhsat sahiplerini aradığında embriyo ya da fetüsün olası ilaç maruziyeti hakkında bilgi edinilmesi ve hamileliğin sonucunun takibi için gereken makul çaba gösterilmelidir.

f.title: Collect as many data elements as possible in pregnancy reports
f.statement: Reports of exposure during pregnancy should contain as many elements as possible to allow assessment of causality between adverse events and exposure; use of standard questionnaires is recommended.

f.title: Report abnormal pregnancy outcomes as serious ICSRs
f.statement: Individual cases of an abnormal outcome associated with a medicine after exposure during pregnancy are classified as serious and should be reported per 2.7, in particular reports of congenital anomalies or developmental delay in the fetus or child, fetal death or spontaneous abortion, and serious suspected adverse reactions in the neonate.

f.title: Do not report pregnancy exposures without ADR as ICSRs but cover them in PBRERs
f.statement: Reports of elective termination without information on congenital malformation, exposure reports without outcome data, or reports of normal outcomes should not be reported as they contain no suspected adverse reaction; they should however be collected and discussed in PBRERs.

Bu durum, raportör tarafından sonlanımın hastalığın progresyonundan kaynaklandığını ve ilaçla ilgili olmadığını özel olarak belirttiği durumlar haricinde geçerlidir.

rows.quote_en: Reports of lack of therapeutic efficacy should be recorded, followed up if data are missing from the report, and reported to the Agency within 15 days regardless of whether they are serious. Particular attention should be paid to reports concerning medicines used to treat critical conditions or life-threatening diseases, vaccines and contraceptives. This applies except where the reporter has specifically stated that the outcome was due to disease progression and was not related to the medicine.

f.title: Apply clinical judgement to decide whether lack of efficacy is reportable
f.statement: Clinical judgement should be applied when considering whether lack-of-efficacy cases are reportable; for example, an antibiotic used in a life-threatening situation that is in fact inappropriate for the infective agent need not be reported.

rows.quote: Terapötik etkisizlik olgularının bildirim için uygun olup olmadığı düşünülürken klinik yargıya başvurulmalıdır. Örneğin, yaşamı tehdit edici bir durumda kullanılan antibiyotik, aslında enfektif ajan için uygun olmayan bir ilaçsa bildirilmesi gerekli değildir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Clinical judgement should be applied when considering whether cases of lack of therapeutic efficacy qualify for reporting. For example, an antibiotic used in a life-threatening situation does not need to be reported if it was in fact not appropriate for the infective agent.

f.title: Report life-threatening infections from new resistant strains within 15 days
f.statement: Life-threatening infections thought to result from lack of efficacy due to development of a new resistant strain of a bacterium previously considered susceptible should be reported within 15 days.

rows.quote: Bununla birlikte, daha önce duyarlı olarak kabul edilen bir bakterinin yeni dirençli bir suşunun gelişiminden kaynaklandığı düşünülen terapötik etkisizliğe bağlı yaşamı tehdit edici enfeksiyonlar 15 gün içinde bildirilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: However, life-threatening infections due to lack of therapeutic efficacy thought to result from the development of a new resistant strain of a bacterium previously considered susceptible should be reported within 15 days.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Life-threatening infections from lack of efficacy apparently due to a newly resistant strain (clock start and day type borrowed from 2.7 / 2.7.1)

f.title: Report vaccine lack of efficacy and consider strain-replacement signals
f.statement: Lack-of-efficacy cases for vaccines should be reported, particularly regarding signals of reduced immunogenicity in a subgroup, waning immunity or strain replacement; spontaneous HCP reports of lack of efficacy should be considered as potentially signalling strain replacement.

rows.quote: Aşılar için terapötik etkisizlik olguları, özellikle aşılananların alt grubunda immünojenisite azalmasına dair sinyaller, immünitede azalma ya da suş değişimi açısından bildirilmelidir. Bu sonuncusuyla ilgili olarak, sağlık mesleği mensubu tarafından spontan olarak bildirilen terapötik etkisizlik raporlarının bir suş değişimi sinyali oluşturuyor olabileceği düşünülmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For vaccines, cases of lack of therapeutic efficacy should be reported, in particular with a view to signals of reduced immunogenicity in a subgroup of vaccinees, waning immunity or strain replacement. With regard to the latter, it should be considered that spontaneously reported cases of lack of therapeutic efficacy by a healthcare professional may constitute a signal of strain replacement.

f.title: Report only valid ICSRs; day 0 is first awareness by any MAH personnel
f.statement: Only valid ICSRs should be reported. The reporting time for a valid ICSR starts when information containing the minimum reportability criteria comes to the attention of TITCK or any MAH personnel, including medical representatives and the contract PV service organisation (CPVSO); this date should be taken as day 0, in practice the first working day the receiving party becomes aware of the information.

rows.quote: Yalnızca geçerli BOGR’ler (bkz. 2.2) bildirilmelidir. Geçerli bir BOGR’nin bildirim süresi, asgari raporlanabilirlik kriterlerini içeren bilgilerin Kurumun ya da ürün tanıtım Doküman No İlk Yayın Tarihi Revizyon Tarihi Revizyon No Sayfa FVK-KLVZ-01 12/06/2014 15/11/2022 1 13/28 elemanlarının ve Sözleşmeli Farmakovijilans Hizmet Kuruluşu (SFHK) da dahil olmak üzere ruhsat sahibinin herhangi bir personelinin dikkatine sunulmasıyla başlar. Bu tarih 0. gün olarak kabul edilmelidir. Uygulamada bu tarih, bilgileri alan tarafın bilgilerden haberdar olduğu ilk iş günüdür.

The reporting time frame for a valid ICSR starts when the information containing the minimum reportability criteria comes to the attention of the Agency or of any personnel of the marketing authorisation holder, including medical sales [page running header ... FVK-KLVZ-01 12/06/2014 15/11/2022 1 13/28] representatives and the Contract Pharmacovigilance Service Organisation (CPVSO). This date should be considered day 0. In practice, this date is the first working day on which the receiving party becomes aware of the information.

f.title: Have clear procedures and detailed agreements with contracted parties for reporting
f.statement: Where the MAH has contracted a person or organisation, clear procedures and detailed agreements between the parties are required so the MAH can meet its reporting obligations; these should specify processes for exchange of safety information including timelines and regulatory reporting responsibilities and avoid duplicate reporting to TITCK.

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibinin bir kişi ya da kuruluş ile sözleşme imzalamış olduğu durumlarda, ruhsat sahibinin bildirim yükümlülüklerine uyabilmesinin sağlanması için, taraflar arasında açık prosedürlerin ve detaylı anlaşmaların mevcut olması gereklidir. Bu prosedürler özellikle, zaman çerçeveleri ve düzenleyici otoritelere bildirim sorumlulukları dahil olmak üzere güvenlilik bilgilerinin alışverişi ile ilgili süreçleri belirtmeli ve Kuruma mükerrer bildirimi önlemelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified: "gereklidir" proves Mandatory and the quote names the MAH; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where the marketing authorisation holder has signed a contract with a person or organisation, clear procedures and detailed agreements between the parties are necessary to ensure that the marketing authorisation holder can comply with its reporting obligations. These procedures should in particular specify the processes for exchanging safety information, including time frames and responsibilities for reporting to regulatory authorities, and should avoid duplicate reporting to the Agency.

f.title: Start literature ICSR clock on awareness of a publication with minimum information
f.statement: For ICSRs described in scientific and medical literature, the reporting clock starts on awareness of a publication containing minimum reporting information (day 0). If an organisation is contracted for literature screening and/or reporting (an organisation able to screen for screening only; a CPVSO if ICSRs are also prepared), detailed agreements should be in place so the MAH can meet its reporting obligations.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Bilimsel ve tıbbi literatürde tanımlanan BOGR’ler için, bildirim süresi bildirim için minimum bilgileri içeren bir yayından haberdar olunması ile başlar (0. gün). Literatür taramalarının yapılması ve/veya geçerli BOGR’lerin bildirilmesi için bir kuruluş (sadece tarama yapılacaksa taramayı yapabilecek kapasiteye sahip bir kuruluş, hem tarama yapılacak hem de BOGR hazırlanacak ise SFHK) ile sözleşme imzalanmışsa, ruhsat sahibinin bildirim yükümlülüklerine uyabilmesinin sağlanması için detaylı anlaşmalar mevcut olmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: added vendor-oversight process (contracted literature screening agreements). Double-check: clock-start definition plus a -meli agreement duty; actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For ICSRs described in the scientific and medical literature, the reporting time frame starts on awareness of a publication containing the minimum information for reporting (day 0). If a contract has been signed with an organisation for performing literature searches and/or reporting valid ICSRs (an organisation capable of performing the search if only searching is to be done; a CPVSO if both searching and ICSR preparation are to be done), detailed agreements should be in place to ensure that the marketing authorisation holder can comply with its reporting obligations.

f.title: Start the follow-up reporting clock on receipt of significant follow-up information
f.statement: For a previously reported case, the reporting time for a follow-up report starts from the date significant follow-up information is received. Significant follow-up means new medical or administrative information that may affect assessment or management of a case or change its seriousness; non-significant information includes updated comments on case assessment or corrections of typographical errors.

rows.deadline: From the date significant follow-up information is received
rows.quote: Daha önce bildirilmiş olan bir olgu için ilave önemli bilgiler alındığı takdirde takip raporunun sunulması için bildirim süresi, ilgili takip bilgilerinin alındığı tarihten itibaren başlar. Bildirim açısından, anlamlı takip bilgileri, bir olgunun değerlendirilmesini ya da yönetimini etkileyebilecek veya bunun ciddiyet kriterlerini değiştirebilecek yeni tıbbi veya idari bilgiler anlamına gelmektedir. Anlamlı olmayan bilgiler, olgu değerlendirmesi hakkındaki güncellenmiş yorumları ya da olgunun önceki versiyonundaki yazım hatalarının düzeltilmesini içermektedir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: present-tense clock-start rule ("başlar") with a definition; Mandatory level is a judgement call; actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where significant additional information is received for a previously reported case, the reporting time frame for submitting the follow-up report starts from the date on which the relevant follow-up information was received. For reporting purposes, significant follow-up information means new medical or administrative information that could affect the assessment or management of a case or could change its seriousness criteria. Non-significant information includes updated comments on the case assessment or corrections of typographical errors in the previous version of the case.

f.title: Report valid serious ICSRs within 15 calendar days, including downgraded cases
f.statement: Valid serious ICSRs must be reported as soon as possible, and in no case later than 15 calendar days from first receipt of the information by any MAH personnel, including medical representatives, CPVSO and other contracted organisations. This applies to initial and follow-up information. A case initially reported as serious and later assessed as non-serious on new follow-up information should still be reported within 15 days.

rows.deadline: Within 15 calendar days of first receipt by any MAH personnel
rows.quote: Genel olarak, geçerli ciddi BOGR’lerin mümkün olan en kısa sürede bildirilmesi gerekmektedir; ancak hiçbir durumda bu süre, bilgilerin ürün tanıtım elemanları, SFHK ve sözleşmeli diğer kuruluşlar da dahil olmak üzere ruhsat sahibinin herhangi bir personeli tarafından ilk kez alınmasından itibaren 15 takvim gününü geçmemelidir. Bu kural ilk bilgiler ve takip bilgileri için geçerlidir. Başlangıçta “ciddi” şeklinde bildirilen bir olgu daha sonra yeni takip bilgilerine dayanılarak “ciddi değil” şeklinde değerlendirilirse, bu bilgiler yine de 15 gün içinde bildirilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified: "gerekmektedir" and 15 calendar days from first receipt by any MAH personnel; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In general, valid serious ICSRs need to be reported as soon as possible, but in no case should this period exceed 15 calendar days from the first receipt of the information by any personnel of the marketing authorisation holder, including medical sales representatives, CPVSOs and other contracted organisations. This rule applies to initial information and follow-up information. If a case initially reported as "serious" is subsequently assessed as "non-serious" on the basis of new follow-up information, this information should nevertheless be reported within 15 days.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Valid serious ICSRs, initial and follow-up information

f.title: Have a system to collect and record spontaneous and study adverse reaction reports
f.statement: Each MAH should have a system to collect and record adverse reaction reports, whether spontaneously reported by HCPs or consumers or occurring within a post-authorisation study.
f.clause: 3.1 Responsibilities of the marketing authorisation holder

rows.quote: Her ruhsat sahibi, gerek sağlık mesleği mensupları veya tüketiciler tarafından spontan olarak bildirilen gerekse ruhsatlandırma sonrası çalışma kapsamında gerçekleşen advers reaksiyon raporlarını toplamak ve kaydetmek için bir sistem bulundurmalıdır.
rows.location: 3.1 Responsibilities of the marketing authorisation holder

rows.quote_en: Each marketing authorisation holder should have a system for collecting and recording reports of adverse reactions, whether reported spontaneously by healthcare professionals or consumers or occurring within a post-authorisation study.

f.title: Ensure ADR traceability and retain PV data for authorisation life plus 10 years
f.statement: MAHs should establish mechanisms ensuring follow-up and traceability of adverse reaction reports while protecting data confidentiality. PV data and documents for an authorised medicine should be retained for as long as the product is authorised and for at least 10 years after the authorisation has expired.
f.clause: 3.1 Responsibilities of the marketing authorisation holder

rows.deadline: While authorised and at least 10 years after the authorisation expires
rows.quote: Ruhsat sahipleri verilerin gizliliğini koruyacak şekilde advers reaksiyon raporlarının takip ve izlenebilirliğini sağlayacak mekanizmalar oluşturmalıdır. Ruhsatlı ilaç ile ilgili farmakovijilans veri ve belgeleri, ilaç ruhsatlı olduğu sürece ve ruhsatın süresi bittikten sonra en az 10 yıl boyunca saklanmalıdır.
rows.location: 3.1 Responsibilities of the marketing authorisation holder
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified against the source: quote names the actor and proves the modal verb and the whole statement; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders should establish mechanisms to ensure the follow-up and traceability of adverse reaction reports while protecting the confidentiality of the data. Pharmacovigilance data and documents relating to the authorised medicine should be kept for as long as the medicine is authorised and for at least 10 years after the marketing authorisation has ceased to exist.

f.title: Record spontaneous adverse reaction reports occurring in Turkey
f.statement: MAHs will record adverse reaction reports occurring in Turkey that are brought to their attention spontaneously by HCPs or consumers, including reports received electronically or by any other appropriate means.

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahipleri Türkiye’de gerçekleşen ve sağlık mesleği mensupları veya tüketiciler tarafından spontan olarak dikkatlerine sunulan advers reaksiyon raporlarını kaydedeceklerdir. Bu, elektronik ortamdan veya diğer tüm uygun yöntemlerden alınan raporları kapsamaktadır.
rows.review_note: Review: split: website form/contact details sentence ("yer vermelidirler", Recommended) moved to a new row; this row keeps the prescriptive-future duty "kaydedeceklerdir" = Mandatory. rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders shall record reports of adverse reactions occurring in Türkiye and brought to their attention spontaneously by healthcare professionals or consumers. This covers reports received electronically or by any other appropriate means.

f.title: Provide an ADR reporting form or contact details on company websites
f.statement: To facilitate suspected adverse reaction reporting, MAHs should include an adverse reaction reporting form or appropriate contact details on their websites.

rows.quote: Bu amaçla ruhsat sahipleri, şüpheli advers reaksiyon bildirimlerini kolaylaştırmak için advers reaksiyon bildirim formu ya da uygun iletişim bilgilerine web sitelerinde yer vermelidirler.

rows.quote_en: For this purpose, marketing authorisation holders should include an adverse reaction reporting form or appropriate contact details on their websites to facilitate the reporting of suspected adverse reactions.

f.title: Monitor authorised active substances by systematic literature review per Annex 3
f.statement: MAHs should monitor the active substances they hold authorisations for, in line with 2.1.1.2 and Annex 3, through widely used systematic literature review and access to reference databases.
f.clause: 3.1.2 Case reports published in scientific and medical literature

rows.location: 3.1.2 Case reports published in scientific and medical literature

rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders should monitor the active substances for which they hold marketing authorisations, in line with 2.1.1.2 and Annex 3, by widely used systematic literature review and by accessing a reference database.

f.title: Exclude articles where another MAH's product is the suspect
f.statement: Articles may be excluded from the MAH's reporting if another MAH's medicine is the suspect medicine.
f.clause: 3.1.2 Case reports published in scientific and medical literature
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Eğer başka bir ruhsat sahibinin ilacı şüpheli ilaç ise makaleler ruhsat sahibinin raporlamasının dışında tutulabilir.

f.title: Report literature cases to TÜFAM when the brand is not named
f.statement: If the brand name is not stated in the article, all MAHs of medicines containing the active substance are obliged to report to TÜFAM.
f.clause: 3.1.2 Case reports published in scientific and medical literature

rows.quote: Müstahzar adı makalede belirtilmemişse, ilgili etkin maddeyi içeren ilaçların tüm ruhsat sahipleri TÜFAM’a bildirim yapmakla yükümlüdür.

rows.quote_en: If the proprietary name is not stated in the article, all marketing authorisation holders of medicines containing the active substance concerned are obliged to report to TÜFAM.

f.title: Notify TITCK immediately of new safety information in published analyses and discuss in PBRER
f.statement: If new safety information affecting the benefit-risk profile is suspected in articles presenting analyses of public databases or summarising post-authorisation study results, it should be reported to TITCK immediately and discussed and analysed in the relevant PBRER sections for its effect on the benefit-risk profile.
f.clause: 3.1.2 Case reports published in scientific and medical literature

rows.quote: Halka açık veri tabanlarından veri analizlerini sunan veya ruhsatlandırma sonrası çalışmaların sonuçlarını özetleyen makalelerde ilacın yarar/risk profilini etkileyecek herhangi bir yeni güvenlilik bilgisinin varlığından şüphe ediliyorsa, Kuruma derhal bildirilmeli ve ilgili periyodik yarar/risk değerlendirme raporunun gerekli bölümlerinde ilacın yarar/risk profiline etkisi açısından tartışılmalı ve analiz edilmelidir.

rows.quote_en: If the existence of any new safety information that would affect the benefit/risk profile of the medicine is suspected in articles presenting analyses of data from public databases or summarising the results of post-authorisation studies, it should be reported to the Agency immediately and should be discussed and analysed for its impact on the benefit/risk profile of the medicine in the relevant sections of the related periodic benefit/risk evaluation report.

f.title: Report ICSRs for ADRs associated with falsified or defective medicines
f.statement: If a suspected adverse reaction is associated with a suspected or confirmed falsified medicine or a quality defect, an ICSR should be reported; its seriousness depends on that of the reported suspected adverse reactions per 1.3.4.
f.clause: 3.1.3 Suspected adverse reactions related to quality defects or falsified medicines

rows.quote: Şüpheli advers reaksiyon, şüpheli veya doğrulanmış sahte ilaç veya ilacın kalite kusuru ile ilişkili ise, BOGR bildirilmelidir. BOGR’nin ciddiyeti, 1.3.4.’de belirtilen açıklamalar doğrultusunda raporlanan şüpheli advers reaksiyonların ciddiyetine bağlıdır.
rows.location: 3.1.3 Suspected adverse reactions related to quality defects or falsified medicines

rows.quote_en: If a suspected adverse reaction is associated with a suspected or confirmed falsified medicine or a quality defect of a medicine, an ICSR should be reported. The seriousness of the ICSR depends on the seriousness of the reported suspected adverse reactions, in line with the explanations in 1.3.4.

f.title: Investigate quality-defect ADRs promptly and report confirmed defects to manufacturer and TITCK
f.statement: Because urgent recall measures may be needed, MAHs should have a system ensuring rapid investigation of suspected adverse reaction reports related to falsified medicines and quality defects and separate reporting of confirmed quality defects to the manufacturer and to TITCK.
f.clause: 3.1.3 Suspected adverse reactions related to quality defects or falsified medicines

rows.quote: Bu yüzden, ruhsat sahipleri sahte ilaç ve ilaçların kalite kusurları ile ilgili şüpheli advers reaksiyon raporlarının kısa sürede araştırılmasını ve doğrulanan kalite kusurlarının ayrı olarak üreticiye ve Kuruma bildirilmesini sağlayacak bir sistem bulundurmalıdır.
rows.location: 3.1.3 Suspected adverse reactions related to quality defects or falsified medicines
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified against the source: quote names the actor and proves the modal verb and the whole statement; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Therefore, marketing authorisation holders should have a system that ensures that reports of suspected adverse reactions relating to falsified medicines and quality defects of medicines are investigated promptly and that confirmed quality defects are notified separately to the manufacturer and to the Agency.

f.title: Report suspected transmission of infectious agents as serious within 15 days
f.statement: Suspected transmission of an infectious agent via a medicine should be assessed as a serious adverse reaction and reported within 15 days; if no other criterion applies, its seriousness should be considered an important medical event. This also applies to vaccines.
f.clause: 3.1.4 Suspected transmission of an infectious agent via a medicinal product

f.title: Have a system to report infectious agent transmission to manufacturer, Public Health and TITCK
f.statement: The MAH should have a system to report transmission of an infectious agent via a medicine to the manufacturer, the Public Health Institution and TITCK.

rows.quote: Bu sebeple, ruhsat sahibi enfeksiyöz ajanın ilaç yoluyla bulaşmasını üreticiye, Halk Sağlığı Kurumuna ve Türkiye İlaç ve Tıbbi Cihaz Kurumuna bildirecek bir sistem bulundurmalıdır.

f.title: Focus on known transmissible agents but consider unknown agents and differentiate cause and source

These assessments and proposals may be included as the marketing authorisation holder's comment, also stating any confusion or inconsistencies in the information reported by the primary source. If the ICSR results in the notification of an Emerging Safety Issue (see 3.1.5), a summary of the points of concern and the proposed actions should be included.

Both positive and negative results should be reported. Tests should be coded in accordance with MedDRA.

f.statement: If it is not possible to provide information on tests and test results in a structured way, the information may be given as free text.

f.title: Non-significant follow-up information need not be reported
f.statement: A follow-up report containing non-significant information does not need to be reported, for example minor changes to some dates or correction of typographical errors in the previous case version that do not affect case assessment or transmission.

rows.quote: Buna karşın, önemli olmayan bilgi içeren bir takip raporunun bildirilmesi gerekmemektedir. Bu duruma örnek olarak, olgunun değerlendirilmesi veya aktarımı için sorun yaratmayacak, bazı tarihlerdeki küçük değişiklikler veya önceki olgu versiyonundaki bazı yazım hatalarının düzeltilmesi gibi değişiklikler sayılabilir.

f.title: Apply medical judgement to date of birth and MedDRA term changes in follow-up
f.statement: Medical judgement should be applied to a change in date of birth, which is a significant correction (e.g. inconsistencies in age). Coding changes due to MedDRA version changes may be considered non-significant if they do not affect medical content, but a MedDRA term resulting from a change in interpretation of a previously reported reaction may be significant and should therefore be reported.

rows.quote: Doğum tarihindeki bir değişiklik önemli bir düzeltme olduğu için tıbbi yargıya başvurulmalıdır (örn; hastanın yaş bilgisindeki tezatlıklarda). Aynı şekilde, MedDRA’daki versiyon değişikliği nedeniyle kodlamada meydana gelen değişiklikler (geçerli terimin geçerli olmayan terim konumuna gelmesi) olgunun tıbbi içeriğini etkilemediği sürece önemli olmayan bir değişiklik olarak görülebilir. Fakat önceden raporlanmış, şüpheli advers reaksiyonun yorumlanmasındaki bir değişiklikten kaynaklanan bir MedDRA terimi önemli bir değişiklik teşkil edebilir ve bu yüzden raporlanmalıdır.

rows.quote_en: Medical judgement should be applied, since a change in the date of birth is a significant correction (e.g. where there are contradictions in the patient's age information). Likewise, changes in coding resulting from a version change in MedDRA (a current term becoming non-current) may be regarded as non-significant as long as they do not affect the medical content of the case. However, a MedDRA term resulting from a change in the interpretation of a previously reported suspected adverse reaction may constitute a significant change and should therefore be reported.

f.title: Report parent and child/fetus information in one parent-child report
f.statement: Where a fetus or breastfed newborn was exposed to medicines through a parent and shows suspected adverse reactions (other than early spontaneous abortion/fetal death), information on both parent and child/fetus will be provided in the same report ("parent-child/fetus report"); patient characteristics apply to the child/fetus only, and parent characteristics should be entered under relevant medical history.

rows.quote: Fetüsün veya emzirilen yenidoğanın ebeveyni üzerinden bir veya birkaç ilaca maruz kaldığı ve (erken spontan kürtaj/fetüs ölümü dışında) bir veya daha fazla şüpheli advers reaksiyonları gösterdiği durumlarda, hem ebeveyn hem de çocuk/fetüs hakkındaki bilgi aynı raporda sağlanacaktır. İlaca ek maruz kalmanın kaynağı olan ebeveyn (anne veya baba) ile ilgili özellikler “ilgili tıbbi öykü” alanına yazılmalıdır.

These cases are referred to as "parent-child/foetus reports". The information in the "Patient characteristics" section applies only to the child/foetus. The characteristics of the parent (mother or father) who was the source of exposure to the medicine should be entered in the "relevant medical history" field.

f.title: Prepare linked separate reports when both parent and child react, and report only the mother for miscarriage
f.statement: If both parent and child/fetus show suspected reactions, two separate cross-referenced reports will be prepared. If no reaction affects the child, no parent-child report is needed but the parent report should include pregnancy and exposure information in relevant medical history. For miscarriage or early spontaneous abortion only the mother needs to be reported; if the father took the medicine, it should be stated in relevant medical history.
f.clause: 4.5.1 Use of medicines during pregnancy and breastfeeding

rows.quote: Eğer hem ebeveyn hem de çocuk/fetüs şüphelenen advers reaksiyonları gösteriyorsa, iki ayrı rapor, örneğin bir tanesi ebeveyn (anne veya baba) ve bir tanesi de çocuk/fetüs için olmak üzere düzenlenecektir fakat bu raporlar birbirine atıfta bulunmalıdır. Eğer çocuğu etkileyen herhangi bir reaksiyon yok ise, ebeveyn-çocuk/fetus raporu gerekmemektedir. Ancak ebeveyn için hazırlanan raporda ilgili tıbbi öykü bölümünde gebelik ve ilaç maruziyeti ile ilgili bilgiler yer almalıdır. Düşük veya erken spontan kürtaj olgularında yalnızca annenin raporlanması gerekmektedir, Ancak, eğer ilaç baba tarafından alınmış ise ilgili tıbbi öykü bölümünde baba tarafından alınan ilaç belirtmelidir.

rows.quote_en: If both the parent and the child/foetus experience suspected adverse reactions, two separate reports shall be prepared, e.g. one for the parent (mother or father) and one for the child/foetus, but these reports should refer to each other. If there is no reaction affecting the child, a parent-child/foetus report is not needed. However, the report prepared for the parent should contain information on the pregnancy and the medicine exposure in the relevant medical history section. In cases of miscarriage or early spontaneous abortion, only the mother needs to be reported; however, if the medicine was taken by the father, the medicine taken by the father should be stated in the relevant medical history section.
