rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi, ciddi BOGR’lerin bildirilmesine veya ciddi ve ciddi olmayan BOGR’lerin periyodik yarar/risk değerlendirme raporlarında sunulmasına ek olarak, ruhsat başvurusunun yapılması ile ruhsatın verilmesi arasındaki dönemde ilaçla ilgili olarak tüm dünyada edinilen deneyimleri incelemekle yükümlüdür. Tüm dünyada edinilen deneyimler, yayımlanmış bilimsel ve tıbbi literatürü içermektedir. Ruhsat başvurusunun yapılması ile ruhsatın verilmesi arasındaki dönem için literatür taraması, incelenmekte olan ilacın yarar/risk değerlendirmesini etkileyebilecek bilgiler sağlayan yayımlanmış makalelerin belirlenmesi için gerçekleştirilmelidir.
rows.location: Annex 3.1 When to start and stop literature screening
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified against the source: quote names the actor and proves the modal verb and the whole statement; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In addition to reporting serious ICSRs, or presenting serious and non-serious ICSRs in periodic benefit/risk evaluation reports, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to review worldwide experience with the medicine in the period between submission of the marketing authorisation application and granting of the authorisation. Worldwide experience includes the published scientific and medical literature. Literature screening for the period between submission of the application and granting of the authorisation should be carried out to identify published articles providing information that may affect the benefit/risk assessment of the medicine under evaluation.

f.title: Screen literature for all authorised products from application while the MA is active
f.statement: For PBRER and emerging safety issue purposes, the literature screening requirement is independent of marketing status; literature screening should be performed for all authorised products regardless of commercial status, and must start with submission of the application and continue while the authorisation is active.
f.clause: Annex 3.1 When to start and stop literature screening
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.deadline: From submission of the application while the authorisation is active
rows.quote: Periyodik yarar/risk değerlendirme raporlarının hazırlanması ve yeni görülen güvenlilik sorunlarının bildirimi ile ilgili amaçlar doğrultusunda, literatür taraması gerekliliği ilacın pazarlanma durumundan bağımsızdır. Literatür taraması, ticari durumuna bakılmaksızın, ruhsatı bulunan tüm ürünler için gerçekleştirilmelidir. Dolayısıyla, literatür taramasının ruhsat başvurusunun yapılması ile başlaması ve ruhsat aktif halde iken devam etmesi gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Annex 3.1 When to start and stop literature screening
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "-meli" and "gerekmektedir" combined; actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For the purposes of preparing periodic benefit/risk evaluation reports and notifying emerging safety issues, the literature screening requirement is independent of the marketing status of the medicine. Literature screening should be carried out for all products holding a marketing authorisation, regardless of their commercial status. Therefore, literature screening needs to start with submission of the marketing authorisation application and continue while the authorisation is active.

f.title: Identify the most appropriate literature sources for each product
f.statement: The MAH should be able to identify the most appropriate sources in published literature for each medicine.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Dolasıyla ruhsat sahibi her ilaç için yayımlanmış literatür arasından en uygun kaynakları belirleyebilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: verified against the source: quote names the actor and proves the modal verb and the whole statement; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Therefore, the marketing authorisation holder should be able to identify the most appropriate sources among the published literature for each medicine.

f.title: Review meeting abstracts and MAH-sponsored literature for ICSRs and PBRERs
f.statement: Published abstracts and drafts presented at meetings should be reviewed for ICSRs requiring reporting and for inclusion in PBRERs. The MAH is not obliged to attend all such meetings, but where its staff attend or it sponsors the meeting, the relevant articles are expected to be available in the MAH's pharmacovigilance system.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Toplantılarda sunulan yayınlanmış ilgili özetler ve taslak metinler, bildirilmeleri gereken BOGR’ler açısından ve periyodik yarar/risk değerlendirme raporlarına dahil edilme açısından incelenmelidir. Ruhsat sahibinin bu tür toplantıların tümüne katılma zorunluluğu yoktur; ancak bu toplantılarda ruhsat sahibinin personelinin bulunması veya toplantının destekleyiciliğini ruhsat sahibinin üstlenmesi halinde, ilgili makalelerin ruhsat sahibinin farmakovijilans sisteminde mevcut olması beklenir.
rows.review_note: Review: split: the Mandatory sentence on MAH-prepared/sponsored literature ("gerekmektedir") moved to a new row; this row stays Recommended (-melidir, beklenir). Double-check: "-meli" plus "beklenir": row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Published relevant abstracts and manuscripts presented at meetings should be reviewed for ICSRs that need to be reported and for inclusion in periodic benefit/risk evaluation reports. The marketing authorisation holder is not obliged to attend all such meetings; however, if the marketing authorisation holder's personnel are present at such meetings or the marketing authorisation holder sponsors the meeting, the relevant articles are expected to be available in the marketing authorisation holder's pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: Review MAH-prepared or sponsored literature so ICSRs reach TÜFAM before publication
f.statement: Literature prepared or sponsored by the MAH must be reviewed so that ICSRs can be reported to TÜFAM, as appropriate, before publication. If ICSRs come to the MAH's attention through this route, they should be processed in the same way as ICSRs identified in database searches or journal review.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Ayrıca, ruhsat sahibinin hazırladığı veya destekleyiciliğini üstlendiği literatürün incelenmesi gerekmektedir, böylelikle BOGR gerektiği şekilde, yayından önce TÜFAM’a bildirilebilir. BOGR’ler bu kaynak yoluyla ruhsat sahibinin dikkatine sunulduysa, raporlar veri tabanı taraması veya dergi incelemesi esnasında tespit edilen BOGR’ler ile aynı şekilde işleme tabi tutulmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: added (split from 0123): "gerekmektedir" = Mandatory with a before-publication timing. Double-check: verified: "gerekmektedir" and before-publication timing; MAH named; no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In addition, the literature prepared or sponsored by the marketing authorisation holder needs to be reviewed, so that the ICSR can be reported to TÜFAM before publication as required. If ICSRs have come to the attention of the marketing authorisation holder through this source, the reports should be processed in the same way as ICSRs identified during a database search or journal review.

f.title: Fit database choice, retrieval approach, terms and limits to the search purpose
f.statement: Decisions on database selection, the approach to record retrieval, the choice of terms or text and the application of limits must be appropriate to the purpose of the search.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Veri tabanı seçimine ilişkin kararların, kayıt alınmasında kullanılan yaklaşımın, terim veya metin seçiminin ve sınırlamaların uygulanmasının taramanın amacına uygun olması gerekmektedir.
rows.review_note: Review: added: missed requirement in Annex 3.3 ("gerekmektedir" = Mandatory). Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts; row moved after 0152 to follow source order (Annex 3.3 after 3.2). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Decisions on the choice of database, the approach to record retrieval, the selection of terms or text and the application of limits need to be appropriate to the purpose of the search.

f.title: Test complex searches and select appropriate search terms
f.statement: For complex searches an initial test search is required to check relevant records are not missed; terms appropriate to the research subject and database used should be selected.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Dolasıyla, karmaşık taramalarda ilgili kayıtların atlanmadığının kontrol edilmesi için başlangıçta test taraması yapılması gerekmektedir, fakat farmakovijilans amaçlarına yönelik tarama yapılması halinde bile geri dönüşteki kabul edilebilir kayıp belli değildir. Araştırma konusu ve kullanılan veri tabanına uygun terimler seçilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "gerekmektedir" plus -meli: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Therefore, for complex searches, an initial test search needs to be performed to check that relevant records are not missed, but even when searching for pharmacovigilance purposes the acceptable loss of recall is not defined. Terms appropriate to the research topic and the database used should be selected.

f.title: Search active substances, not only brand names
f.statement: Searches should retrieve records for active substances, not only brand names; excipients and adjuvants with pharmacological effect may also be included.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Taramalar sadece müstahzar isimlerine değil etkin maddelerin kayıtlarına erişilmesi için de yapılmalıdır. Farmakolojik etkiye sahip eksipiyan ve adjuvan (yardımcı) maddeler de bu taramaya dâhil edilebilir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: -meli plus -ebilir: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Searches should be performed to retrieve records not only of proprietary names but also of active substances. Excipients and adjuvants with pharmacological effects may also be included in this search.

f.title: Include articles without specified dosage form or route
f.statement: Records with dosage forms and routes different from the product may be excluded from case searches, but articles not specifying the dosage form and route should be included.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Literatürde olgu taraması yapılması sırasında ilgili üründen farklı farmasötik form ve ilaç veriliş yolları içeren kayıtların taramaya dâhil edilmemesi mümkündür. Ancak farmasötik form ve ilaç veriliş yollarının belirtilmediği makaleler taramaya dâhil edilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "mümkündür" plus -meli: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When screening the literature for cases, it is possible not to include in the search records concerning pharmaceutical forms and routes of administration different from those of the product concerned. However, articles in which the pharmaceutical form and route of administration are not stated should be included in the search.

f.title: Ensure searches capture special situations and do not exclude unbranded products
f.statement: The search should also allow access to poorly indexed information on overdose, medication error, abuse, misuse, off-label use or occupational exposure; searches should not systematically exclude records of unbranded products or other companies' brands.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Tarama, aynı zamanda yetersiz şekilde indekslenebilen aşırı doz, kullanım hatası, ilaç suistimali, kötüye kullanım, endikasyon dışı kullanım veya mesleki maruziyete ilişkin bilgilere erişime olanak Doküman No İlk Yayın Tarihi Revizyon Tarihi Revizyon No Sayfa FVK-KLVZ-01 12/06/2014 15/11/2022 1 25/28 vermelidir. Taramalar markası olmayan ürünlerin veya diğer firma markalarının kayıtlarını sürekli olarak tarama dışı bırakmamalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote spans the page 25 running header; verbatim as in text. Double-check: quote includes the running page header (Doküman No ... page/28) inside the sentence. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The search should also allow access to information on overdose, medication error, drug abuse, misuse, off-label use or occupational exposure, which may be poorly indexed [page running header ... FVK-KLVZ-01 12/06/2014 15/11/2022 1 25/28]. Searches should not systematically exclude records of unbranded products or other companies' brands.

f.title: Apply search limits only in line with the search purpose
f.statement: If limits are applied, they should be appropriate to the purpose of the search.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Eğer sınırlama yapılacaksa, araştırmanın amacına uygun düşecek şekilde yapılmalıdır.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: If limits are to be applied, they should be applied in a way appropriate to the purpose of the search.

f.title: Cover the whole period including records added late or retrospectively
f.statement: Searches should cover the whole time period (e.g. records added later on the search day should be in the next search) and access all records added during that period, not only those first entered or published, so updated or retrospectively added records are retrieved; unclear points should be checked with the database provider.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Taramanın belirli bir zaman aralığının tümünü kapsadığı unutulmamalıdır, örneğin tarama yapılan günün ileriki saatlerinde eklenen kayıtlar bir sonraki taramada yer almalıdır. Tarama aynı zamanda sadece belirli bir süre zarfında ilk kez girilen veya yayımlanan değil bu sürenin tamamında eklenen kayıtlara erişimi sağlamalıdır (böylelikle güncellenen veya geriye dönük olarak eklenen kayıtlara erişilebilir). Söz konusu duruma ilişkin açık olmayan bir husus olduğu takdirde veri tabanı sağlayıcıyla kontrol edilmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: It should be borne in mind that the search covers the whole of a given time period; for example, records added later on the day the search is performed should be included in the next search. The search should also allow access to records added during the whole of that period, not only those first entered or published within a given period (so that updated or retrospectively added records can be retrieved). Where anything about this is unclear, it should be checked with the database provider.

f.title: Keep records of literature searches and retain results
f.statement: Records of literature searches should be kept per the Regulation; MAHs should exercise due diligence in searching published literature; keeping a record of search construction, database used and date is always good practice; search results must be retained for an appropriate period, especially when no results are obtained.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Literatür taramalarının kayıtları, Yönetmelikte tanımlanan gerekliliklere uygun şekilde tutulmalıdır. Ruhsat sahipleri yayınlanmış bilimsel ve tıbbi literatürü taramak için gerekli özeni göstermelidir. Taramanın yapısı, kullanılan veri tabanı ve taramanın yapıldığı tarih ile ilgili bir kaydın tutulması her zaman iyi bir uygulamadır. Ayrıca, özellikle tarama sırasında sonuç elde edilemediğinde tarama sonuçlarının uygun bir dönem için saklanması gereklidir.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: combines -meli, "good practice" and "gereklidir" sentences; Mandatory level applies only to retention of results. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Records of literature searches should be kept in accordance with the requirements defined in the Regulation. Marketing authorisation holders should exercise due diligence in searching the published scientific and medical literature. It is always good practice to keep a record of the search construction, the database used and the date the search was performed. In addition, it is necessary to keep the search results for an appropriate period, especially when the search yields no results.

f.title: Extract and review title, citation and abstract of search results
f.statement: In line with the need to provide the full citation and identify relevant publications, the title, citation and abstract (if available) should without fail be extracted and reviewed.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Bir makale için tam atıfının sunulması ve ilgili yayınların saptanması gerekliliğine uygun şekilde, başlık, atıf ve özet (varsa) mutlaka çıkarılmalı ve incelenmelidir.
rows.review_note: Review: level kept Mandatory: "mutlaka çıkarılmalı ve incelenmelidir" (must be extracted); same reasoning as 0005. rows.quote_en: In accordance with the need to provide the full citation for an article and to identify relevant publications, the title, citation and abstract (if available) should without fail be retrieved and reviewed.

f.title: Ensure literature reviewers are trained to identify relevant articles
f.statement: Persons reviewing search results are expected to be trained to identify relevant articles; this may be an information specialist trained in PV or a PV specialist knowledgeable about the database used.
f.clause: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles

rows.quote: Tarama sonuçlarını inceleyen kişilerin ilgili makaleleri saptayabilecek eğitime sahip olması beklenir. Bu kişi, farmakovijilans konusunda eğitim almış bir bilişim uzmanı ya da kullanılan veri tabanı konusunda bilgi sahibi olan bir farmakovijilans uzmanı olabilir.
rows.location: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote extended with the next sentence ("Bu kişi ... olabilir") that the statement already used; "beklenir" read as Recommended. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Persons reviewing search results are expected to have training enabling them to identify relevant articles. This person may be an information specialist trained in pharmacovigilance or a pharmacovigilance specialist with knowledge of the database used.

f.title: Record that search results were reviewed
f.statement: A record must be kept that search results were reviewed, to demonstrate a systematic approach to collecting information on suspected adverse reactions from literature.
f.clause: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Literatür kaynaklarından şüpheli advers reaksiyonlar hakkında bilgilerin toplanmasında sistematik bir yaklaşım kullanıldığının gösterilmesi için tarama sonuçlarının incelendiğine dair kayıt tutulması gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "gerekmektedir" proves Mandatory; actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Records need to be kept showing that search results have been reviewed, to demonstrate that a systematic approach has been used in collecting information on suspected adverse reactions from literature sources.

f.title: Quality-check a sample of literature review and article selection
f.statement: Quality control of a sample of literature review/article selection is recommended to check whether the primary reviewer identified relevant articles.
f.clause: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Birincil inceleme sorumlusunun ilgili makaleleri saptayıp saptayamadığını kontrol etmek için bir literatür incelemesi/makale seçimi örnekleminde kalite kontrol yapılması tavsiye edilir.
rows.location: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "tavsiye edilir" proves Recommended; actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Quality control of a sample of the literature review/article selection is recommended to check whether the primary reviewer identifies the relevant articles.

f.title: Use literature review also for PBRER, identifying studies without ICSRs
f.statement: The review should also serve as the basis for compiling articles for the PBRER; therefore studies without ICSRs as well as event reports not meeting reporting criteria should be identified.
f.clause: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles

rows.quote: İnceleme periyodik yarar/risk değerlendirme raporunun üretilmesinde makalelerin derlenip düzenlenmesi için dayanak olarak da kullanılmalıdır; bu nedenle, raporlama için gerekli kriterleri karşılamayan olay raporlarının yanı sıra BOGR içermeyen çalışmalar da saptanmalıdır.
rows.location: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The review should also be used as the basis for compiling and organising articles for the production of the periodic benefit/risk evaluation report; therefore studies not containing ICSRs, as well as reports of events not meeting the criteria required for reporting, should also be identified.

f.title: Obtain full articles for potentially relevant search results
f.statement: Even if search output contains enough information for a valid ICSR, the article should be requested; all articles should be obtained for search results potentially relevant to PV requirements, with urgency proportionate to the content and need for action.
f.clause: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Tarama çıktıları geçerli bir BOGR olmak için yeterli bilgi içerebilir; yine de makale talep edilmelidir. Farmakovijilans gereklilikleri açısından ilgili olma olasılığı bulunan tarama sonuçları için tüm makaleler alınmalıdır; çünkü bunlar geçerli BOGR’ler ya da ilgili güvenlilik bilgileri içerebilir. Bu işlemlerin ivediliği, değerlendirilen konunun içeriği ve değerlendirme sonucu herhangi bir aksiyon gerekip gerekmediği ile orantılı olmalıdır.
rows.location: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Search outputs may contain enough information to be a valid ICSR; nevertheless the article should be requested. All articles should be obtained for search results likely to be relevant to pharmacovigilance requirements, because they may contain valid ICSRs or relevant safety information. The urgency of these actions should be proportionate to the content of the matter being assessed and to whether any action is needed as a result of the assessment.

f.title: Assume ownership for active-substance articles without stated source or brand
f.statement: If no source of the medicine is stated and/or the brand name is not stated, ownership of the medicine should be assumed for articles about the active substance.
f.clause: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Belirtilmiş bir ilaç kaynağı yoksa ve/veya müstahzar adı belirtilmemişse, ilacın mülkiyeti etkin madde hakkındaki makaleler için üstlenilmelidir.
rows.location: Annex 3.6 Review and selection of articles

Double-check: statement: removed the parenthetical pointer to 3.1.2, which the quote does not contain; actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: If no source of the medicine is stated and/or the proprietary name is not stated, ownership of the medicine should be assumed for articles about the active substance.

f.title: Apply literature day 0 rules and obtain articles promptly
f.statement: Day zero is the day any MAH or contractor staff becomes aware of a publication with minimum reportable information for an ICSR. For an abstract with a reportable reaction found in weekly screening, day zero is the screening day; for articles ordered after screening, day zero is when minimum information for a valid ICSR is available. MAHs should obtain articles confirming case validity promptly.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Sıfırıncı gün ruhsat sahibinin veya sözleşmeli kuruluşun herhangi bir personelinin bir BOGR için raporlanabilecek minimum bilgi içeren bir yayının farkına vardığı gündür. Bazen makalenin veri tabanında yer aldığı tarihi tespit etmek mümkün olabilse de, haftalık literatür taramasında tespit edilen raporlanabilir bir advers reaksiyonun yer aldığı özet için sıfırıncı gün taramanın yapıldığı gün olarak kabul edilir. Literatür taramasının ardından sipariş edilen makaleler için sıfırıncı gün, bir BOGR’nin geçerli olması için gereken minimum bilginin sağlandığı gündür. Ruhsat sahipleri bir olgunun geçerliliğini teyit edecek makaleleri ivedilikle temin etmelidirler.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: mostly day-0 definitions with one named -meli duty. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Day zero is the day on which any personnel of the marketing authorisation holder or of the contracted organisation becomes aware of a publication containing the minimum information reportable for an ICSR. Although it may sometimes be possible to establish the date on which the article appeared in the database, for an abstract containing a reportable adverse reaction identified in the weekly literature search, day zero is regarded as the day the search was performed. For articles ordered following a literature search, day zero is the day on which the minimum information required for an ICSR to be valid is available. Marketing authorisation holders should obtain promptly the articles that will confirm the validity of a case.

f.title: Check the database for previously reported literature cases
f.statement: When reporting literature ICSRs, the MAH should check its database and identify previously reported cases to avoid duplicate reporting.

f.title: Retain responsibility and detail outsourced literature screening in a contract
f.statement: Other organisations' services may be used for literature screening, but responsibility for screening and subsequent reporting remains with the MAH; screening and transmission should be detailed in a contract between the MAH and service provider.
f.clause: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services

rows.quote: Yayınlanmış bilimsel ve tıbbi literatürlerin taramasını yapmak için başka kuruluşların servislerini kullanmak mümkündür. Bu takdirde, taramaların yapılması ve sonrasındaki raporlamaya ait sorumluluklar yine ruhsat sahibine aittir. Literatür taraması ve iletimi ruhsat sahibi ve servis sağlayıcı arasında yapılacak bir kontrat ile detaylandırılmalıdır.
rows.location: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote extended with its lead-in ("... servislerini kullanmak mümkündür"); responsibility statement ("aittir") and -meli contract duty combined: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: It is possible to use the services of other organisations to search the published scientific and medical literature. In this case, responsibility for performing the searches and for the subsequent reporting still lies with the marketing authorisation holder. Literature searching and transmission should be detailed in a contract between the marketing authorisation holder and the service provider.

f.title: Ensure shared literature services meet each MAH's needs
f.statement: Several MAHs may share a third party's services for generic active substances; each MAH should ensure the search and service meet its own needs and obligations.
f.clause: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services

rows.quote: Jenerik etkin maddelere ait taramaları yapmak için birden fazla ruhsat sahibi üçüncü bir tarafın servislerini paylaşabilirler. Bu durumda, her bir ruhsat sahibi araştırma ve servisin kendi ihtiyaç ve yükümlülüklerine uygun olduğundan emin olmalıdır.
rows.location: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: permission plus -meli duty: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: More than one marketing authorisation holder may share the services of a third party to perform searches for generic active substances. In this case, each marketing authorisation holder should make sure that the search and the service are appropriate to its own needs and obligations.

f.title: Evaluate the literature service provider and document the agreement
f.statement: When working with a literature service provider, the services need to be evaluated to determine whether agreed needs and obligations are met; in all cases the agreement should be clearly documented.
f.clause: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi literatür taraması için belirli bir servis sağlayıcıyla çalıştığında, anlaşmada yer alan ihtiyaçların ve yükümlülüklerin karşılanıp karşılanmadığını belirlemek için servis(ler)in değerlendirilmesi gerekir. Her durumda, anlaşma net bir şekilde belgelendirilmelidir.
rows.location: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "gerekir" plus -meli: row joins sentences of different modal strength, so the single level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When the marketing authorisation holder works with a particular service provider for literature searching, the service(s) need to be evaluated to determine whether the needs and obligations in the agreement are being met. In all cases the agreement should be clearly documented.

f.title: Start the literature ICSR clock at earliest awareness by MAH or contractor
f.statement: The time for reporting ICSRs starts when the MAH or contracted organisation, whichever is earlier, becomes aware of the minimum information.
f.clause: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services

rows.deadline: From earliest awareness of minimum information by MAH or contractor
rows.quote: BOGR’lerin raporlanması için süre ruhsat sahibi ya da sözleşmeli kuruluş (hangisi erken olursa) tarafından minimum bilginin farkına varılması ile başlar.
rows.location: Annex 3.9 Contracting out literature search services
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: present-tense clock-start rule ("başlar"); Mandatory level is a judgement call. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The time frame for reporting ICSRs starts with awareness of the minimum information by the marketing authorisation holder or the contracted organisation (whichever is earlier).

f.title: Send the literature copy only once for multi-patient articles
f.statement: When literature refers to more than one patient, the copy of the literature should be sent only once.
f.clause: Annex 3.10 Submission of copies of literature articles

rows.quote: Literatür birden fazla hastanın tanımına atıfta bulunduğunda, literatürün kopyası sadece bir kez gönderilmelidir.
rows.location: Annex 3.10 Submission of copies of literature articles
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actor inferred (MAH) from section context; the quote is passive and does not name who acts. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When the literature refers to the description of more than one patient, a copy of the literature should be sent only once.
